name: Sample Orthodontics
tagline: Orthodontic care planned around how you breathe, bite and grow

freeConsultation.note: Your first orthodontic consultation is free. We explain what we can and cannot treat, with no obligation.

payments.name: Monthly payment plans
payments.description: Spread treatment cost over the length of treatment, interest-free.

payments.name: Cards and HSA/FSA
payments.description: Major credit and debit cards and health savings accounts.

reasons.title: We look for the cause
reasons.body: We check jaw growth, tongue posture and breathing before we plan tooth movement.

reasons.title: We measure, then plan
reasons.body: 3D scans replace guesswork and messy impressions.

reasons.title: Earlier can mean simpler
reasons.body: For growing children, guiding development now can shorten treatment later.

reasons.title: A plan that is yours
reasons.body: You get a written plan with timelines and costs before anything starts.
